claim_boundary.ratios_are: clean-latency analytical lifecycle ratios at identical per-point structural resources

cycle_model.accumulator_update_drain: 3 cycles per bank-legal context issue round
cycle_model.bank_rounds: max(max contexts mapped to one bank, ceil(popcount/min(F,banks)))
cycle_model.chunk_directory: one cycle per source chunk for each nonempty tile; empty tiles bypass before directory scan
cycle_model.commit: 8 contexts times three cycles = 24 cycles per nonempty tile on one commit port
cycle_model.factor_fill: one request plus two-cycle response = 3 cycles per descriptor
cycle_model.qualification: analytical clean-latency lifecycle DSE; stalls are not measured and physical SRAM/macros are absent
cycle_model.weight_fill: one request plus two-cycle response = 3 cycles per descriptor

decision.next_gate: full-width VCS plus physical SRAM/bank timing and matched DC/PTPX

same_resource_rule.accumulator_ports_per_bank: one lane-vector read and one lane-vector write
same_resource_rule.comparison: bit_sparse versus context_factorized at identical lanes, fanout adders, accumulator banks, factor/weight ports, response latency, descriptor capacity, chunk directory, accumulator capacity and commit port
same_resource_rule.descriptor_buffer_depth: 8*source_chunk entries for both modes, sized for the bit-sparse worst case
same_resource_rule.stage3_fallback_resource_and_cycles: unchanged and charged in scope-corrected projection
